title: 36A_geneexp
source_name_ch1: Healthy donor number 36 treated by AZM
characteristics_ch1: cell type: Sorted T cells from frozen PBMCs
treatment_protocol_ch1: Two days following activation, sample were retrieved from the incubator and kept on ice. Following 10X Genomics Feature Barcoding recommendations, cells were washed, labeled with antibody with high affinity to a known Cell Surface Protein coupled to a Feature Barcode oligonucleotide that identifies the antibody for 30 minutes at 4°C. Cell suspensions were subjected to in Gel Bead Emulsion using Chromium 10x Genomics controller according to manufacturer guidelines. Chromium™ Next GEM Single Cell 3’ Kit v3.1 (10X Genomics, cat. 1000268) and 3’ Feature Barcorde Kit (10X Genomics, cat. 1000262) were used to prepare reagents.
growth_protocol_ch1: CD3+ cells were isolated from frozen PBMC (Miltenyi, cat.130-050-101) and resuspended at 1 million cells per mL in antibiotic free medium with RPMI-1640 (Gibco, cat. 61870036) supplemented with 10% human AB serum (Biowest, cat. S4190-100). Treatments (azithromycin 10 mg/L, SIGMA cat. PZ0007, reconstituted in DMSO) or control (dimethylsulfoxide, equal volume of azithromycin) were added to the medium, then 200000 cells were plated in 96 flat-bottom plate. After one day of culture, activation withwas performed with a 1:1 cell:Dynadeads Human T-activated CD3/CD28 ratio following manufacturer instructions (Gibco, cat. 11131D).
extract_protocol_ch1: To perform single cell RNA sequencing after cDNA amplification, the concentration of each sample was measured using Tapestation 2200 (Agilent). To prepare the cDNA libraries for 10x Genomics Chromium controller, we used the single-cell 3′ v3.1 kit (Dual Index) with Feature Barcode technology for Cell Surface Protein, following manufacturer guidelines. QC libraries were performed using Tapestation 2200 (Agilent). The input number of cells was estimated at 10,000 cells/samples. FASTQ files were obtained with bcl2fastq (Illumina).
Libraries were equimolar pooled to obtain at least 20,000 read pairs per cell and 5,000 read pairs for feature barcode part after sequencing on Illumina Novaseq 6000 (100 cycles cartridge).
description: 10X Genomics Feature Barcode technology and Single Cell Targeted Gene Expression.
data_processing: Alignment, filtering, barcode counting, UMI counting were performed with count function from 10x Genomics Cell Ranger (version 6.0) using GRCh38 genome assembly as reference data.

Cell surface proteins were identified with specific oligonucleotide sequence (Format TotalSeqB, Biolegend): CD3_TotalSeqB, CD45RA_TotalSeqB, CCR4_TotalSeqB, CD4_TotalSeqB, CD8_TotalSeqB, CD25_TotalSeqB, PD1_TotalSeqB, CXCR3_TotalSeqB, CCR6_TotalSeqB, CXCR5_TotalSeqB, CCR7_TotalSeqB, CD161_TotalSeqB, CTLA4_TotalSeqB, CD95_TotalSeqB, HLA-DR_TotalSeqB, ICOS_TotalSeqB, CD39_TotalSeqB, CD27_TotalSeq, KLRG1_TotalSeqB, CD28_TotalSeqB, CD38_TotalSeqB, CD127_TotalSeqB, CD73_TotalSeqB, TCRVa72_TotalSeqB. All sequences are available on https://www.biolegend.com/en-us/totalseq/barcode-lookup

Supplementary_files_format_and_content: The cellranger pipeline outputs an HDF5 file containing per-molecule information for all molecules that contain a valid barcode, a valid UMI, and were assigned with high confidence to a gene or Feature Barcode. This HDF5 file contains data corresponding to the observed molecules, as well as data about the libraries and feature set(s) usedEach element of the matrix is the number of UMIs associated with a feature (row) and a barcode (column). This file can be input into third-party packages and allows users to wrangle the barcode-feature matrix (e.g. to filter outlier cells, run dimensionality reduction, normalize gene expression).
